IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Monday 23 November
Winds: Northwesterly 15 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots during the morning and early afternoon. Winds tending westerly in the morning.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Westerly 1 to 2 metres inshore, increasing to 2 to 3 metres offshore during the morning.
Swell: Northeasterly 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 95% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm offshore later tonight. Possible small hail this evening.

Tuesday 24 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 15 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots during the morning. Winds decreasing to 10 to 15 knots in the late evening.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Westerly 1.5 to 2.5 metres, tending southwesterly 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Northeasterly 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm offshore in the early morning. Possible small hail in the morning and afternoon.

Wednesday 25 November
Winds: West to northwesterly 10 to 15 knots tending north to northwesterly 15 to 20 knots during the morning then tending southeast to southwesterly during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres offshore.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
warnings: Strong Wind Warning for Monday for South East Coast
